summary: The Cadaverous Bear is a powerful undead skeletal bear in Fang Lair. Along with the weaker Cadaverous Guar and Senche-Tiger, it makes up the Cadaverous Menagerie, the second boss fight of the dungeon. Players should focus damage on the Cadaverous Bear when convenient, as once it is defeated the rest of the Undead Menagerie will immediately die. Cadaverous Dire Wolves will also spawn during the fight and spontaneously combust when in close proximity to a player.
